frequency_question: How often do bilateral water treaties scheduled for expiration get formally renewed prior to deadline when specific joint committee precursors are active?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral water resource management treaties facing explicit expiration dates where joint technical committees have met beforehand. Excludes unilateral abrogation or unrelated trade treaties.

cases.name: Indus Waters Treaty implementation and permanent commission adjustments
Columbia River Treaty regime extensions and operational protocols
Ukrainian-Russian Sea of Azov and Kerch Strait water use agreements
Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase agreements

provenance_note: 5 cases named, 6 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.2x)
coverage_note: 5 named major benchmarks; estimated total universe of comparable major riparian treaty renewals is roughly 6 to 8 globally over the modern era.
known_gaps: Excludes minor local municipal cross-border water sharing agreements.
skeleton: Bilateral riparian treaty renewals globally where joint committee meetings occurred in the 24 months prior to expiration.
multiplier: 5 observed renewals out of 6 comparable historical major river treaty expiration windows with active joint technical committee precursors.
validity_reason: The base rate reflects long-term state practice regarding institutionalized water-sharing treaty renewals and remains stable through the resolution window.
